fields.name: appIntroduction
fields.value: Automate branded order PDFs with Flow. Customize templates visually or with HTML and CSS.

fields.name: appDetails
fields.value: Create order summaries and packing slips that match your store. Design templates visually or paste HTML and CSS, then use Shopify Flow to prepare expiring private PDF links. Review activity, retry failures, and revoke links from the app. Plans count unique orders, so both document types and reprints share one unit per billing period. Uses recent orders; edited or refunded orders are currently unsupported. Does not create fiscal invoices or send customer email.

fields.name: testingInstructions
fields.value:
Development preview. Staging is stopped between attended tests. Do not submit for review until continuous hosting, protected-data review and the remaining production checks are complete. The configured app origin is https://commerce.fullbleed.dev.

1. Install Fullbleed Commerce. No separate account is needed. Use Shopify test billing only on a development store.
2. In Documents, choose a synthetic recent order and create an order summary or packing slip. Open Download.
3. In Template studio, change text or styles visually, or edit HTML / CSS. Preview and save. In Brand settings, configure seller lines, paper, design and accent. Reprint to verify the saved template.
4. Enable Flow in Automations. In Shopify Flow, use Order created followed by Create order summary link and Create packing slip link. Pass each action's downloadUrl and expiresAt to private order fields or an intended staff destination. The app itself sends no customer email.
5. Run the workflow on a synthetic order. Check Completed, both Fullbleed activity entries, the two saved expiries and both PDF downloads. Pause automation and verify those links stop working.
6. In Plan and usage, test Studio/Scale changes and reprint the same order. Both document types and reprints share one unique-order unit per billing period. No automatic overage charges.
7. Uninstall to test data erasure.

The captioned screencast shows actual installation, saved visual/CSS customization, an existing development-store trial, a manual retry of an already configured Flow workflow, document activity and pause. It does not show a real merchant payment or a new order-created trigger. Public walkthrough and synthetic PDFs: https://docs.fullbleed.dev/commerce/shopify/.

Current limits: English UI; recent unedited, uncancelled and unrefunded orders; at most 250 items; no fiscal invoicing, shipment-specific fulfillment documents or customer email delivery.
